Question: asalamualykum sir I am looking for job for many years and i have debt, i regular practicing salatul haja but could not find any job or employment please provide any wazifa for me i am very needy, and i i also want to perfome haj i can not afford it. Answer ID: 8951 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2014/1864=D/1429) You should recite the below dua in the morning and evening (after Fajr and Asr): اللھم اکفنی بحلالک عن حرامک و اغننی بفضلک عمن سواک Also, recite ya Lateef ( یا لطیف ) 1100 times with durood 11 times before and after. You needs shall be fulfilled and the debt shall be paid easily, in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
